lines.text: Feel free to drop by anytime.

data.define: To visit someone casually, often without a plan.

example.text: Feel free to drop by anytime.

misuse.text: Don't 'drop by' a stranger's house unannounced.
misuse.why: Even casual visits need a welcome.

data.l1_hook: Passe aqui a qualquer hora esta semana! "drop by"
data.l1_ex: Sinta-se à vontade para dar uma passada ("drop by") a qualquer momento.

native.tip: “drop by” = dar um pulo. Exemplo: “Feel free to drop by anytime.”
